title: A quick estimate from the client's page

steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: Write a short estimate without leaving the client's page. Start on Clients.

steps.caption: New estimate
steps.narration: Under Quick actions, choose New estimate.

steps.caption: The first line
steps.narration: On the first line, type what the work is.

steps.caption: Unit price
steps.narration: And the unit price. The line total works itself out.

steps.value: Remove the old carpet, level the subfloor, install plank and new base trim.
steps.caption: Scope and details
steps.narration: Under Scope and details, say what is included. Your client reads this part.

steps.caption: Add line
steps.narration: Choose Add line for the next one.

steps.caption: The second line
steps.narration: Type the second line the same way.

steps.caption: The total
steps.narration: The total adds up at the bottom as you type.

steps.caption: Saved on the client's page
steps.narration: The estimate is saved on the client's page as a draft. Preview it, then send it from here.

steps.caption: The full builder
steps.narration: For a bigger job, the full builder under Estimates adds work from your price book.

youtube.title: How to write a quick estimate on a client's page | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Write a short estimate straight from a client's page in ConstructHUB CRM: a title, a few typed lines with quantity, unit price and scope, and Create estimate. It is saved as a draft on the client, ready to preview and send. Recorded in a demo workspace.
